verdicts.reason: Both are a crop of the original with the centre panel narrowed. Neither rearranges anything for the banner, and in both the decorative X, slash and circle marks sit outside the panel on top of the busy photo instead of framing its corners. A's panel stops well short of the bottom edge, so it looks like it is floating, and its headline is smaller. B's slightly larger text and nearly full-height panel stay closer to the original, but its X and lower slash land right on people's hands and its circle crowds the bottom edge. In both, 'Join WADE team' has an awkward gap before 'team'.
